ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited reported robust Q1 FY26 results, with consolidated PAT up 70% and EBITDA up 31% year-on-year, primarily driven by strong fluoropolymer growth and an improved product mix. The company anticipates continued growth from its fluoropolymer segment, expects significant revenue uplift from the early commercialization of R32, and strategically positions its Battery Chemicals business to capitalize on substantial US subsidies and supply chain shifts. While recent US tariffs impact a few specialized new fluoropolymers, management asserts no significant business impact due to the unique nature of these products and the ability to negotiate pricing.
